## New proved/restricted theorem

For the typed private-root fragment `R_rootK`, with one globally fixed support bound `K`, exact preserved signs/types/source tags, extensional downstream consumers, and the authenticated GF(2) rows of LSPV-1/375, binary-gate `ER2` and the fragment are polynomially equivalent:

`W_RrootK(F) <= W_ER2(F) <= C_K (|F|+W_RrootK(F)+3)^4`.

The same holds for worst-case envelopes. B1, B2 and B3 are therefore each equivalent between these two fixed proof systems, but remain OPEN.

## Full `R_mix341`: do not overclaim

REFEREE299 already proves `W_Rmix(F)<=W_ER2(F)`. The converse is **OPEN**. REFEREE335 proves private-root polynomial-bit normalization, but does not supply the common-support/type/source-authentication coercion required by LSPV-1/359 and /375. The authoritative prose has no numeric global support bound or full executable parser.

Consequently, for full `R_mix341`, only `B1_ER=>B1_Rmix`, `B2_ER=>B2_Rmix`, and `B3_ER=>B3_Rmix` are certified. Reverse implications are open.
